Theorem
[maximum principles theorem] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Theorem A.1\group Kleiner–Lott Analytic Appendices

Let $M$ be a closed manifold, let $\{ g(t)\} _{t \in [0,T]}$ be a smooth one-parameter family of Riemannian metrics, and let $\{ X(t)\} _{t \in [0,T]}$ be a smooth one-parameter family of vector fields. Let $F \: : \: \R \times [0,T] \rightarrow \R $ be Lipschitz. If $u=u(x,t)$ is $C^2$ in $x$, $C^1$ in $t$, and \begin{equation} \frac{\partial u}{\partial t} \: \le \: \triangle _{g(t)}u \: + \: X(t)u \: + \: F(u,t), \end{equation} and $\phi \: : \: [0,T] \rightarrow \R $ solves $\frac{d\phi }{dt} \: = \: F(\phi (t),t)$ with $\phi (0)=\alpha $, then $u(\cdot ,0)\leq \alpha $ implies $u(\cdot ,t)\leq \phi (t)$ for all $t\in [0,T]$.
